name: EPIC 251350334

text.card: A red giant 3,431 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 1.20 solar masses and 9.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,757 K at its surface.
